title: Guian, Eastern Samar braces for 40°C heat index

blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The municipal government of Guiuan in Eastern Samar warned residents of possible heat-related illnesses on Monday, as the heat index was forecast to reach 40 degrees Celsius, classified as under extreme caution. In its heat index advisory, the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (MDRRMO) said the hot, humid conditions could cause fatigue, heat cramps, and heat exhaustion, urging the public to take precautions against prolonged sun exposure. The advisory, citing the Ambient Weather Network (AWN), also forecast partly cloudy to cloudy skies, with isolated rain showers or thunderstorms.
